## Goal

Retire the four M1 risks in docs/roadmap.md before M3 feature work: AudioRecord capture, high-pitch LPC, AGC detection, Kotlin throughput and GC pauses

## Done when

Each spike has a Proposed ADR in docs/adr/ with measured results; owner reviews them
seen.title: M1 Spikes: one ADR per device-risk spike
